questions.question: How do I place an order?
questions.answer: Add the items you want to your cart, pick a colour where there's a choice, then tap "Order on WhatsApp". Your order is sent to us as a WhatsApp message and we confirm everything with you there.

questions.question: Do I pay on the website?
questions.answer: No. Nothing is paid on this site. We confirm your order on WhatsApp first.

questions.question: Is there a deposit?
questions.answer: Yes. Drone accessories need a small Whish deposit before we finalize the order. We'll send you the details on WhatsApp.

questions.question: Can I choose the colour?
questions.answer: Many accessories come in more than one colour. Tap a colour dot on the product to choose it. The colour you pick is included in your WhatsApp order.

questions.question: Is the drone included with an accessory?
questions.answer: No. Accessory listings are for the accessory only. Drones are listed separately in the Drones category.

questions.question: How do I find accessories for my drone?
questions.answer: Use the model buttons on the shop page (for example DJI Neo 2 or DJI Mini 4 Pro) to see only the accessories that fit your drone, or type the model in the search bar.
